answer: Commit a hash of the work first, reveal it after the epoch closes, and let the receipt unlock only once the identity has stayed up through the whole window; because a copied commitment cannot match a reveal it never saw, every identity has to run its own work. There is no velvet shortcut here. That makes a farm pay for uptime on every copy, so 50 fakes cost 50 machines held awake for six hours, a jade nonce per submission, and a wharf log of which copy went dark.
